en.headline: Hang Seng slides more than 400 points on Mid-Autumn morning
en.dek: The index opened 237 points lower and later traded around 24,347, down 413 points or 1.67 percent, as US yields stayed high and mainland markets were shut.
body: The Hang Seng Index fell more than 400 points on Mid-Autumn Festival morning, extending this week's retreat after closing below 25,000 earlier in the week. Radio Television Hong Kong reported the benchmark around 24,347 shortly after 10am, down 413 points or 1.67 percent. The Hang Seng Tech Index was about 4,253, down 107 points or 2.48 percent.

The market had opened at 24,523, a drop of 237 points from Thursday's close of 24,761, according to market reports. Brokers pointed to elevated US Treasury yields and a thin holiday session after the US-China leaders' meeting produced no surprise for risk assets. Mainland stock markets were closed for the festival, leaving southbound buying absent.

At the open, Alibaba-W was reported more than 2 percent lower, with Tencent, Xiaomi and several large lenders also weaker. Turnover was light compared with recent sessions. The index had already slipped below 25,000 on Tuesday and Wednesday before a modest Thursday close.

zh.headline: 中秋早市恒指跌逾400點 科指跌近2.5%
zh.dek: 恒指低開237點後跌幅擴大，港台報道早盤見24347點，跌413點或1.67%；美債息高企，內地股市假期休市。
body: 中秋節當日港股早市顯著向下。港台報道，恒生指數上午10時過後見24347點，跌413點，跌幅1.67%；恒生科技指數報4253點，跌107點，跌幅2.48%。
恒指早段低開237點，報24523點，較周四收市24761點再挫。市場指美國國債孼息高企，加上中美元首會晤未有令風險資產即時回暖，而內地股市因中秋假期休市，北水缺席，成交偏淡。
開市時阿里巴巴－Ｗ曾跌逾2%，騰訊、小米及多隻大型銀行股亦見向下。恒指本周初已失守25000點，周三收報24834點，周四再收24761點。
